bulk_indicators: per-sample narrowPeak files (bulk ATAC-seq peak calls)
per-sample TSV/rna.txt expression tables (bulk RNA-seq quantification)
Hi-C loops in .bedpe format (bulk 3D genome contact data)
small number of distinct sample IDs (sampleA/B/C) rather than thousands of cell barcodes
single_cell_indicators: none: no .h5ad, .h5 (10x), .mtx, fragments.tsv.gz, barcodes.tsv, .loom, or CellRanger/ArchR-style outputs found

recommendation: Usable with build-taiji-input: directory contains bulk RNA-seq expression tables, bulk ATAC-seq narrowPeak files, and Hi-C loops (.bedpe) for mm10, which is exactly the input shape Taiji's bulk pipeline consumes. No single-cell artifacts detected, so no sc->pseudobulk aggregation is needed.
caveats: All listed files are zero-byte placeholders; classification is based on filenames/extensions only. Before running Taiji, verify that the RNA tables contain gene-level expression and that narrowPeak files are non-empty.
Both .tsv and .rna.txt exist per sample; confirm which one build-taiji-input should consume to avoid double-counting.
